title: Resolve the constant-pair encoding and integrity blockers from replay #528
body:
## Goal
Report, do not fix. Use the saved constant-pair evidence from accepted #528 to test whether prepared pinned sources explain the BDHb insertion/value encoding and BDPW integrity dependencies. Expected gain: docs/research/poc/pair/constant-rules-0106.md gives an evidence-backed rule or a precise remaining blocker, letting the next shaper decide whether any bounded edit is justified. No session can run LabVIEW. Do not write a changed VI, modify the reviewed tool, claim native behaviour/save-version preservation, or implement product code.
## Acceptance
- [ ] Record SHA256 pins for every consumed repository evidence file and prepared source file, including source revision and exact file/line or symbol citations. Verify the two separate constant VI hashes against their saved comparison before probing; preserve mismatches rather than refreshing pins.
- [ ] Read findings-0105.md and the saved constant comparisons/alignment. Investigate the candidate insertion at decompressed offset 312 and value transition at left 545/right 549 using bounded heap context. Distinguish parsed nodes/type/value/length boundaries from ambiguous byte alignment. Account for the same BDHb change in both save modes and the normal DFDS change without treating either correlation as a general editing rule.
- [ ] Search the prepared source inventory narrowly for relevant heap, constant and BDPW implementations. Compare with prior POC findings before repeating source searches; if a prior absence remains unchanged, cite it and stop that branch. Test explicit source-derived BDPW dependencies against the existing pinned fixtures where possible. Do not guess unbounded hash recipes, bypass passwords, delete caches, copy target resources into a purported edit, or infer integrity from parser acceptance.
- [ ] Write docs/research/poc/pair/constant-rules-0106.json containing schema_version 1, verdict (rules-supported, needs-evidence, or source-blocked), input_hashes, source_pins, probes, unresolved, limitations. Each probe records hypothesis, provenance, observed result and supported/refuted/unknown conclusion; negative and unavailable-source results are deliverable. Preserve short decisive outputs. Explain BDPW, RTSG, LVSR, code/type dependencies and absent unchanged-save control only to the extent evidence supports them; unknowns remain explicit.
- [ ] Write constant-rules-0106.md (at most 100 lines) with Inputs, Findings, Not established, Verdict sections. Cite JSON probes and pinned source locations; end with one smallest next step. Provide a standalone check_constant_rules_0106.py that checks evidence schema, all repository input hashes, recorded prepared-source pin format and probe conclusions using committed files only; no environment access in this check. The check must fail on missing evidence or malformed/contradictory records, and must not equate rules-supported with native validity.
- [ ] Preserve all original VIs, reviewed files, replay outputs and pins unchanged. New repository outputs stay under docs/research/poc/pair/. No --self-check, corpus restart, replay rerun, benchmark work, owner request or manual commit.
## Verification
python3 docs/research/poc/pair/check_constant_rules_0106.py
The engine has no LABVIEW_ENVIRONMENT or session artifacts; this validates the committed evidence, including a precise negative result, not LabVIEW behaviour.
## Context
- docs/research/poc/pair/findings-0105.md: shaper-read verdict edit-attempt-needs-more; controlled pairs localize candidates but leave encoding/integrity and Save As churn unresolved.
- docs/research/poc/pair/constant-1-separate--constant-2-separate.json: shaper-read raw/decompressed differences; BDPW, HIST, LVSR and RTSG also differ while VCTP/DTHP remain identical in this pair. Original SHA256: constant-1-separate.vi 5fb16358439de9b2b49ae3eb829bba227565ec6e86993f7b7a1a8fcdc352e6d8; constant-2-separate.vi e5844746b85654e4a4c77acb0f4b282fe75ace925e276bcb2db3edbb0227b2d7.
- #528 merged as bba00f7 in accepted iteration 0105. Continue its saved evidence; do not repeat preparation or claim that accepted measurement authorized an edit.
## Budget
Read findings-0105.md, candidates-0105.json (only constant alignments), constant-1-separate--constant-2-separate.json, constant-1-normal--constant-2-normal.json, replay-0105-status.json, fixtures/pins.json and fixtures/authoring.md. Inspect existing docs/research/poc/ blocker findings only for the relevant source-search history. Locate relevant prepared sources with scoped Glob/Grep and read only needed symbols; pinned pylavi revision is 35d2a0318f71dcb87bb9c431dc00700ee6b9fb75. Use LABVIEW_ENVIRONMENT in session probes, never in the final verifier. Do not dump whole large JSON/source files; keep command output short. By halfway through the turn budget save the evidence JSON, even if source-blocked. Stop at a concrete absence with searched paths and terms rather than extending to an open-ended format investigation.
